search.title: Search
search.description: A plain drug, brand, or ingredient name, or an openFDA search expression. A plain value such as aspirin is quoted and OR-ed across the name fields for the selected mode (medicinal product, brand, generic, and substance; recalls also search product description). A value that already contains field:term syntax, such as patient.drug.medicinalproduct:aspirin or openfda.brand_name:"tylenol extra strength", is sent to openFDA unchanged. Required unless you set a brand, generic, or substance name. Do not put an API key here.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Which official openFDA dataset to query. event reads FAERS adverse event reports (/drug/event.json). label reads Structured Product Labeling (/drug/label.json). recall reads drug enforcement reports (/drug/enforcement.json).

brandName.title: Brand name
brandName.description: Optional brand name. Used only when Search is empty. OR-ed with generic name and substance name. Example: Tylenol.

genericName.title: Generic name
genericName.description: Optional generic name. Used only when Search is empty. Example: acetaminophen.

substanceName.title: Substance name
substanceName.description: Optional active substance. Used only when Search is empty. Example: ibuprofen.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of flat rows to save. openFDA chooses the order after the Actor sorts by the dataset date, newest first.

apiKey.title: openFDA API key
apiKey.description: Optional free openFDA API key. Without a key the public limit is 240 requests per minute and 1,000 requests per day per IP. With a key the daily limit is 120,000 requests. The key is sent only as the api_key query parameter to api.fda.gov and is never written to the dataset, the run overview, or the logs. Create one at https://open.fda.gov/apis/authentication/.

skip.title: Skip
skip.description: How many matching openFDA records to skip before saving. Use this to resume a larger result set. openFDA allows skip up to 25000. Leave at 0 for a normal run.
skip.sectionDescription: Pagination resume. Most runs can leave skip at 0.
